purpose: Teach: 邦訳/自由民主党/自由党/角川書店/講じる/可用性/外為/用水

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、海外規定の邦訳資料を整備されますね
lines.en: You're preparing translations of overseas police regulations, I see.
lines.style: Warm observation, leaning in slightly. Tone suggests genuine interest and respect. Measured pace with a light curiosity at the end, not interrogation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、自由民主党議員からのお問い合わせにも対応されますね
lines.en: And you're also handling inquiries from LDP Diet members.
lines.style: Continuing smoothly, building on the previous point. Slightly knowing — acknowledging the breadth of work. Steady, appreciative rhythm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、戦前の自由党の犯罪記録もご研究ですね
lines.en: Even researching crime records from the prewar Liberal Party — that's thorough.
lines.style: Light note of admiration. Slight lean into the historical detail. Warm but not fawning. The respect is genuine underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、角川書店のミステリー部門との連携、頼もしいです
lines.en: And your collaboration with Kadokawa's mystery division is reassuring.
lines.style: Gentle smile in the voice. A touch of humor acknowledging the unusual partnership. Warm, almost playful appreciation of the resourcefulness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新たな対策を講じる準備をされてますね
lines.en: You're preparing new countermeasures as well.
lines.style: Noting this with quiet respect. Slight nod in the tone. Not a question but an acknowledgment of steady, forward-thinking work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯システムの可用性も重視されてますね
lines.en: Crime prevention systems get real emphasis in your work.
lines.style: Observational, understanding. Warm recognition of practical priorities. Even pace, affirming without being performative.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、不正外為取引の捜査もご担当ですね
lines.en: You're also investigating illegal foreign exchange trading.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. No surprise in the voice — just acknowledging another layer of serious work. Professional warmth.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、用水路での事故防止活動もされますね
lines.en: And preventing accidents at irrigation channels — that matters too.
lines.style: Slight shift to softer tone here. Warmth deepens. A recognition that safety work happens at every level. Close, almost intimate understanding.
